name: a throne of folding brass
description: A seat assembled from brass lattice, every strut carrying a smaller copy of the whole frame, unfolding and refolding at the edges without ever finishing.
looks: Every part of it contains a smaller whole one. You follow it in about four levels and have to stop.
It is keeping time with your pulse and improving on it.
The armrest ends in a scroll, and the scroll ends in an armrest, and so on, politely, forever.
says: Sit down. Or do not. Both are already happening.
I am the same shape all the way in.
The ornament is not decoration. The ornament is the load path.
emotes: {it} unfolds a new tier of ornament along one arm and folds it away again, tidily.
{it} ticks, quietly, like a clock going about its business.
A section of {it} rotates through ninety degrees and arrives back where it started, improved.
{it} throws a shadow with more detail in it than {it} has.
asks: How many layers can you actually see? Be honest.
Would you like arms on me? I can do arms.
Does this pattern remind you of something? It reminds everyone of something.
